description: Validerer suppliers-tabel, FK, indeks og kobling til Espresso.

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'suppliers'
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' AND column_name = 'supplier_id'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND c.conkey = ARRAY[a.attnum] JOIN pg_attribute b ON b.attrelid = c.confrelid AND c.confkey = ARRAY[b.attnum] WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND c.conname = 'products_supplier_fk' AND c.conrelid = 'products'::regclass AND a.attname = 'supplier_id' AND c.confrelid = 'suppliers'::regclass AND b.attname = 'id'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ix ON ix.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = i.indkey[0] WHERE i.indrelid = 'products'::regclass AND ix.relname = 'ix_products_supplier' AND i.indnkeyatts = 1 AND i.indisvalid AND i.indpred IS NULL AND a.attname = 'supplier_id'
SELECT p.name, s.name, s.city FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.name = 'Espresso'
assertions.message: Espresso er koblet til Nordic Beans i Aarhus
